increment_paragraph: **SP6-SYMBOLIC-HYPOTHESIS-ATOMS (2026-11-22).** User decision 2026-11-20 (conditions are symbols, not sentences); user 2026-11-22 on SP5 leaving the cJSON hypotheses as English: "We need to convert to be symbolized atoms of hypothesis." The nine resource_hypothesis(detach_*, "...") atoms of cJSON_DetachItemViaPointer (librdkafka/cjson.qv) are C04.18.7 typed atoms, each the typed rendering of its part of the detach_list_representation premise formula over registered C04.18.9 terms (a new SP6 block: the rendering rule, the value sort run and the term #runs, the semantics of |->; Rust RENDERED_VALUE_SORTS/RENDERED_TERMS/check_rendering, specification table, Lean QCore.CjsonTypedAtoms.render); the nine guarded prerequisite symbols repeat each atom's formula; the binding manifest (quant_binding_migration: atom digests, quantifiers and conclusions now typed), the expected graph and the guarded adoption plan were migrated together, and the declaration was re-pinned at the same sites and both revisions (contract_sha256 only). The contract format refuses resource_hypothesis(NAME, "...") under any introducer with the new diagnostic QF002 at parse (qcore_frontend::premise_formula::hypothesis_clause, so on every route; Q000 naming QF002 on the compiler route), and hypothesis::validate refuses an opaque declared atom on the wire as in source; a generated legacy_atom_* (the erasure of a named premise) keeps its opaque statement. Contract inheritance keeps quant proposition clauses literal like every other graph clause (no existing inheritor affected). Tests, examples and fixtures state typed atoms (35 string matches in 11 files plus 4 format!-built at base; after, 20 in 5 files: refusal cases and the frozen compiler fixture only); the source-local checkers cjson_local_binding and plugin_source_witnesses state typed atoms over their bound models. Frozen texts are read through the test-side legacy reader, extended to lift recorded string atoms, graph atoms and guarded symbols (migration.json), with sp2_premise_checkpoint writing this card's recorded edits back first. Spec C04.18.1, C04.18.7, C04.18.9 (SP6 block), grammar G01p/G05, rule 13h, the L21 table and the diagnostics page updated. Lean: QCore.CjsonTypedAtoms (each atom equal to its CjsonRepresentationPremises definition, typed_atoms_are_the_definitions; detach_formula_is_the_nine_typed_atoms; string_is_not_a_hypothesis; hypothesis_vectors_agree bound to the Rust ATOM_DECISION_VECTORS) and QCore.LocalTypedAtoms (the seven source-local atoms), audited. Hypothesis atoms stay evidence-only metadata: no move predicted on any route.
